sharedRules.name: Battle Focus
sharedRules.description:
-> At the start of the battle round: if your Army Faction is AELDARI, you gain 2/4/6 Battle Focus tokens (Incursion/Strike Force/Onslaught).
If your Army Faction is AELDARI:
  -> Actions may be performed when their conditions are met. A unit may perform at most one action per phase; unless stated otherwise, a given action may be triggered once per phase:
    - Swift as the Wind: when a friendly unit is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, spend 1 Battle Focus token, add 2 to the unit's Move characteristic, until the end of the phase (may be triggered more than once per phase if a different unit performs it each time).
    - Flitting Shadows: when a friendly unit is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move or when a friendly unit is set up or after a friendly unit selects targets for its charge but before it makes a Charge move, spend 1 Battle Focus token, your opponent cannot target the unit with Overwatch, until the end of the turn.
    - Star Engines: when a friendly unit is selected to make an Advance move (only usable by one VEHICLE unit), spend 1 Battle Focus token, ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit gain [ASSAULT], until the end of the turn.
    - Sudden Strike: each time a friendly unit ends a Charge move, spend 1 Battle Focus token, add 3" to the unit's Pile-in and Consolidation moves, until the end of the turn.
    - Opportunity Seized: each time an enemy unit Falls Back (only usable by one unit (excluding TITANIC units), the selected unit was engaged with that unit at the start of the phase), spend 1 Battle Focus token, the unit can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".
    - Fade Back: after an enemy unit shoots (only usable by one unit (excluding TITANIC units), during the Shooting phase and in the opponent's turn and the selected unit was hit by an attack from the triggering unit during its just-finished shooting sequence), spend 1 Battle Focus token, the unit can make a Normal move of up to D6+1".
  -> At the end of the battle round: spend all your Battle Focus tokens.

rules.name: Strands of Fate
rules.description:
For the rest of the battle:
  -> At the start of the battle round, if during the first battle round: add a rolled D6 to your Fate dice.
  -> Each time you use a Stratagem, you can:
    -> Spend 1 Fate die.
    -> You gain 1CP.

rules.name: Martial Grace
rules.description:
-> At the start of the battle round: you gain 1 Battle Focus token.
-> Each time a friendly unit performs the Swift As the Wind Agile Manoeuvre, until the end of the phase: add 1 to the triggering unit's Move characteristic.
-> Each time a friendly unit performs an Agile Manoeuvre, if the triggering unit is performing the Fade Back Agile Manoeuvre or the triggering unit is performing the Opportunity Seized Agile Manoeuvre: the triggering unit gets +1 to Agile Manoeuvre rolls.

rules.name: Path of the Warrior
rules.description:
When a friendly unit is selected to shoot (the triggering unit must have ASPECT WARRIORS or AVATAR OF KHAINE) or when a friendly unit is selected to fight (the triggering unit must have ASPECT WARRIORS or AVATAR OF KHAINE), during the Shooting phase or during the Fight phase, if the unit has the ASPECT WARRIORS or AVATAR OF KHAINE keywords, until the end of the phase:
  Select one of the following (Path of the Warrior):
    - You can re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
    - You can re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

rules.name: Far-reaching Doom
rules.description: While the attacking unit is friendly, if the attacking unit has the RANGERS or SHROUD RUNNERS keyword, add 6 to the target's detection range characteristic.

rules.name: Acrobatic Onslaught
rules.description:
All friendly HARLEQUINS units can move over models as though they were not there, during their Charge moves.
You cannot select this Detachment together with another ACROBATIC Detachment.

rules.name: Dance of Distortion
rules.description:
All friendly HARLEQUINS units gain the Stealth ability.
You cannot select this Detachment together with another ACROBATIC Detachment.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
When the unit ends a Charge move:
  -> Select one enemy unit if the selected unit is within Engagement Range of the unit: roll one D6 for each friendly model in the unit that is within Engagement Range of the selected unit: for each 4+, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Each time an enemy unit starts a Fall Back move (the triggering unit must not have MONSTER or VEHICLE), while the triggering unit is within Engagement Range of the unit:
  -> While the triggering unit is Battle-shocked, the triggering unit must take a Desperate Escape test, applying -1 to that test.
  -> While the triggering unit is not Battle-shocked, the triggering unit must take a Desperate Escape test.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this model is leading a unit, the unit gains the Infiltrators ability.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The unit gains the Scouts 9" ability.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The attacking unit gets -1 to Hit rolls.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Weapons with [PSYCHIC] equipped by this model gain [ANTI-MONSTER 2+] and [ANTI-VEHICLE 2+].

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The unit gains the Scouts 6" ability.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Add 3 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time the unit uses ability, you may use this ability, the number of selections of this model's Cruel Amusement ability is 2.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
After deployment, you may use this ability:
  -> Select up to 3 friendly HARLEQUINS units:
    -> For each selected unit:
      -> That unit can be set up on the battlefield.
      -> That unit can be placed into Strategic Reserves, ignoring any limits on units in Strategic Reserves.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
During the Command phase, in your turn, until the start of your next Command phase:
  -> Select one friendly WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit if the selected unit is within 12" of this model:
    -> Add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of INFANTRY models in that unit.
    -> Add 3 to the Objective Control characteristic of MONSTER models in that unit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
During the Command phase, in your turn, until the start of your next Command phase:
  -> Select one friendly WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit (excluding TITANIC units) if the selected unit is within 12" of this model: if the triggering wound roll was a critical, that unit's weapons gain [PRECISION].

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
During the Command phase, in your turn, until the start of your next Command phase:
  -> Select one friendly WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit if the selected unit is within 12" of this model: while making ranged attacks, while the attacking unit is not within 18" of the unit, if the target unit is the same unit as the selected unit, that unit has the Benefit of Cover.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time an enemy unit ends a move, you may use this ability, during the Movement phase, in the opponent's turn, while the triggering unit is within 8" of the unit, while the unit is unengaged, the unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Ranged Eldritch Storm weapons equipped by this model gain [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
After the unit resolves its attacks, during the Shooting phase, in your turn:
  -> Select one enemy unit that was hit by an attack made by the triggering unit during its just-finished shooting sequence: that unit must take a Battle-shock test.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While making melee attacks, you can re-roll the Wound roll for attacks made by this model.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Set this model's Objective Control characteristic to 5.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
You can: Once per battle round per model, while this model is leading a friendly unit with the DIRE AVENGERS or GUARDIANS keyword, when resolving this use:
  -> The Fire Overwatch Stratagem that targets the unit costs 0CP.
  -> While the unit is not within range of an objective marker you control, the unit's Hit rolls succeed only on an unmodified 5+.
  -> While the unit is within range of an objective marker you control, the unit's Hit rolls succeed only on an unmodified 4+.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
While this model is within 3" of a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit:
  -> This model gains the Lone Operative ability.
  -> When the unit starts a move, you may use this ability or when the unit ends a move, you may use this ability:
    -> Select one friendly AELDARI VEHICLE model if the selected unit is within 3" of this model: during the Movement phase, in your turn, that model regains up to D3 lost wounds.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
At the start of your Shooting phase, until the end of the phase:
  -> Select one friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit within 6" of this model visible to this model if the selected unit has the VEHICLE keyword: while making ranged attacks, this unit gets +1 to Hit rolls.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While an enemy unit is within 3" of this unit, subtract 1 from that unit's Objective Control characteristic.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
The unit gains the Deep Strike ability.
-> At the end of your opponent's turn, you may use this ability, once per battle per model: while the unit is unengaged, the unit can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
At the start of the battle or when an enemy unit within 12" of this model is targeted with a Stratagem, you may use this ability, once per turn per unit:
  -> Select one friendly CHARACTER model in the unit: increase the CP cost of that use of the Stratagem by 1CP.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The unit has a 5+ invulnerable save.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Each time battle focus pool is spent:
  -> Roll one D6: on a 3+, you gain 1 Battle Focus token.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit gain [LANCE].

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit gain [ANTI-MONSTER 5+] and [ANTI-VEHICLE 5+].

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Add 12 to the Range characteristic of ranged weapons with [PSYCHIC] equipped by this model.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When an enemy unit within 12" of this model is targeted with a Stratagem, you may use this ability, once per turn per model, increase the CP cost of that use of the Stratagem by 1CP.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
At the end of each phase, if this model was destroyed this phase (1+ times), the first time this battle per model:
  -> Roll one D6: on a 2+, this model can be set up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, with its full wounds remaining.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At the start of the battle round, while this model is on the battlefield or while the Transport this unit is embarked within is on the battlefield, you gain 1 Battle Focus token.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: You can: Once per battle round per model, the Command Re Roll Stratagem that targets the unit costs 0CP.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by this model.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.
Melee weapons equipped by this model gain [PRECISION].

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this model is selected to shoot or when the unit is selected to fight, while this model is leading a ASPECT WARRIORS unit, until the end of the phase, every option of Path of the Warrior is active for the triggering unit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this model is leading a ASPECT WARRIORS unit, against ranged attacks, the attacking unit gets -1 to Wound rolls.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this model is leading a ASPECT WARRIORS unit, add 1 to the unit's Objective Control characteristic.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While making ranged attacks, the unit does not stop being hidden when it attacks.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While making ranged attacks against CHARACTER targets, improve the unit's Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.
